notes.title: Who will be the first to get 50 points?
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

There's lots of people playing THE BUTTON right now. 
Lots of people trying to be THE FIRST on the leaderboards.

Ok.

The first person to LEGALLY achieve 50 points (yes, I know if you cheat) will be immortalized in the game with a message:

- WINNER NAME* was the first person to achieve 50 points.

Good Luck.

*If the name contains inappropriate language, I'll ask for a more appropriate name to show ingame.
